title: Repost and quote — share a post as it is, or with your own words on top

tasks.title: Reposts and quotes, server to card, with demo content

acs.text: WHEN a learner reposts a post THE SYSTEM SHALL record one repost per profile per post (repeating it changes nothing), answer with the viewer's state and the post's repost count, and undo it on request; a missing or deleted post is 404. Every post the API returns carries `repostCount`, `quoteCount` and whether the viewer has reposted it.
scenarios: AC-001 a repost is recorded once and can be undone

acs.text: WHEN a learner posts with `quotedPostId` THE SYSTEM SHALL store a post of theirs that carries the quoted one; the API returns it with `quoted` (the quoted post's author, words, source and time) and the quoted post's `quoteCount` grows. A quote of a post that is later deleted keeps `quoted.id` with its other fields null; quoting a missing post is 404.
scenarios: AC-002 a quote carries the quoted post

acs.text: WHILE the viewer follows a profile THE SYSTEM SHALL put that profile's reposts in the viewer's Following tab at the time of the repost, with `repostedBy` naming who reposted it; a post shows once per page, at its latest entry.
scenarios: AC-003 the network's reposts are in Following

acs.text: The post card SHALL show a repost button (pressed state, count, undone on a second press, restored if the server refuses), a quote button that opens a short form under the post and posts the quote, the quoted post set inside a quote (linking to its page; "This post was deleted" once it is gone), and "<name> reposted" (or "You reposted") above a post a repost brought.
scenarios: AC-004 the post card offers repost and quote

acs.text: The demo community (spec 028) SHALL include reposts and quotes, so the first visit shows both.
scenarios: AC-005 the demo community reposts and quotes
